exposure: stage of pregnancy (first, second, third trimester, post-delivery)
age (mares vs. neonates, specific neonatal age points)
outcome: electrocardiographic (ECG) parameters (heart rate, rhythm, duration and intervals P, PR, QRS, QT, T; amplitude P, R, S, T)
cohort: The study included ten pluriparous American Miniature Horse mares (aged 7-19 years) and their ten newborn foals.
finding: Significant differences were found in ECG parameters, heart rate, respiration rate, and temperature among pregnant mares, non-pregnant mares, and foals, with distinct ECG patterns associated with the reproductive state of mares and notable discrepancies between adult females and neonates.
followup_time: 35 days (for neonates, mares up to 21 days post-delivery)
